description: After re-authenticating Plaud, only checked for recordings dated today (2026-07-15) and declared 'nothing pending to ingest.' Missed a recording from later in the day yesterday (2026-07-14) that had not yet been transcribed/ingested. Did not check for recordings with no-transcript/pending status across the recent window, and did not follow the fetch script's own reconciliation logic (--check / pending queue) before declaring the pipeline caught up.
correction: After a re-auth or any 'is anything pending' check, scan recent recordings (not just the exact current date) for missing/pending transcript status, not just an exact date-string match. Then run the actual ingest — transcript retrieval, calendar cross-reference for speaker/meeting identification, vault write, daily note linking — rather than stopping at 'no recordings found.'
systemic_fix: Update the Plaud check step to always run a recent-window scan (e.g. last 48h) checking transcript status per recording, not a single exact-date match, before reporting nothing pending.
